name: glu
doc: 一般门控线性单元：`glu act a b x = act (a x) · b x`。
stmt: def glu (act : ℝ → ℝ) (a b : ℝ → ℝ) (x : ℝ) : ℝ

name: reglu
stmt: def reglu (a b : ℝ → ℝ) (x : ℝ) : ℝ

name: geglu
stmt: def geglu (a b : ℝ → ℝ) (x : ℝ) : ℝ

name: siluGLU
doc: SiLU-GLU（= Swish-GLU）：门 = SiLU ∘ a，信号 = b。
stmt: def siluGLU (a b : ℝ → ℝ) (x : ℝ) : ℝ

name: glu_is_gated
doc: `SoftMasked act s` ⟹ `glu act a b = (s∘a)·(a·b)`，即 GLU 落在 `Gated` 类中。
stmt:
theorem glu_is_gated {act s : ℝ → ℝ} (hsm : SoftMasked act s) (a b : ℝ → ℝ) :
    Gated (glu act a b) (fun x => s (a x)) (fun x => a x * b x)
proof:
by
  intro x
  unfold glu
  rw [hsm.1 (a x)]
  ring

name: reglu_is_gated
stmt:
theorem reglu_is_gated (a b : ℝ → ℝ) :
    Gated (reglu a b) (fun x => reluSoftMask (a x)) (fun x => a x * b x)

name: geglu_is_gated
stmt:
theorem geglu_is_gated (a b : ℝ → ℝ) :
    Gated (geglu a b) (fun x => geluSoftMask (a x)) (fun x => a x * b x)

name: siluGLU_is_gated
stmt:
theorem siluGLU_is_gated (a b : ℝ → ℝ) :
    Gated (siluGLU a b) (fun x => sigmoid (a x)) (fun x => a x * b x)

name: reluSoftMask_abs_le_one
stmt: lemma reluSoftMask_abs_le_one (x : ℝ) : |reluSoftMask x| ≤ 1

name: geluSoftMask_abs_le_one
stmt: lemma geluSoftMask_abs_le_one (x : ℝ) : |geluSoftMask x| ≤ 1
proof:
by
  have h := gelu_soft_mask_bounds x
  rw [abs_of_nonneg h.1]
  exact h.2

name: sigmoid_abs_le_one
stmt: lemma sigmoid_abs_le_one (x : ℝ) : |sigmoid x| ≤ 1
proof:
by
  have h := sigmoid_bounds x
  rw [abs_of_nonneg (le_of_lt h.1)]
  exact le_of_lt h.2

name: glu_bound
doc: `|act| ≤ 1` ⟹ `|glu act a b x| ≤ |b x|`（门控只缩放、不放大信号）。
stmt:
theorem glu_bound {act : ℝ → ℝ} (hact : ∀ y, |act y| ≤ 1) (a b : ℝ → ℝ) (x : ℝ) :
    |glu act a b x| ≤ |b x|
proof:
by
  unfold glu
  rw [abs_mul]
  calc |act (a x)| * |b x| ≤ 1 * |b x| :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hact (a x)) (abs_nonneg _)
    _ = |b x| := one_mul _

name: glu_mask_bound
doc: 门控型界：`act` 是软掩码 `s` 的激活且 `|s| ≤ 1` ⟹ `|glu act a b x| ≤ |a x · b x|`。
stmt:
theorem glu_mask_bound {act s : ℝ → ℝ} (hsm : SoftMasked act s) (hs : ∀ y, |s y| ≤ 1)
    (a b : ℝ → ℝ) (x : ℝ) : |glu act a b x| ≤ |a x * b x|
proof: gated_abs_le (glu_is_gated hsm a b) (fun y => hs (a y)) x

name: reglu_bound
stmt: theorem reglu_bound (a b : ℝ → ℝ) (x : ℝ) : |reglu a b x| ≤ |a x * b x|
proof: glu_mask_bound relu_is_soft_masked reluSoftMask_abs_le_one a b x

name: geglu_bound
stmt: theorem geglu_bound (a b : ℝ → ℝ) (x : ℝ) : |geglu a b x| ≤ |a x * b x|
proof: glu_mask_bound gelu_is_soft_masked geluSoftMask_abs_le_one a b x

name: siluGLU_bound
stmt: theorem siluGLU_bound (a b : ℝ → ℝ) (x : ℝ) : |siluGLU a b x| ≤ |a x * b x|
proof: glu_mask_bound silu_is_soft_masked sigmoid_abs_le_one a b x

name: glu_ffn_effective
doc: `Σ Wᵢ·glu act a b (Hᵢ) = Σ Wᵢ·(act(a Hᵢ)·b Hᵢ)`（按定义即证）。
stmt:
theorem glu_ffn_effective {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (act a b : ℝ → ℝ) (W H : ι → ℝ) :
    ∑ i, W i * glu act a b (H i) = ∑ i, W i * (act (a (H i)) * b (H i))
proof:
by
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  rfl

name: glu_ffn_effective_gated
doc: 把上一行与门控形式对齐：`= Σ Wᵢ·((s(a Hᵢ))·(a Hᵢ·b Hᵢ))`（`SoftMasked act s` 时）。
proof:
by
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  unfold glu
  rw [hsm.1 (a (H i))]
  ring
